enchantments.tooltip: Eternal Holy Burst: While you are wearing this item, your melee, ranged, and unarmed attacks gain the Holy Burst ability. (This weapon is holy. The weapon deals an additional 1 to 6 good damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 good damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.)
True Seeing: Passive: You gain the benefit of the spell True Seeing.
Constitution +13: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.

Adherent of the Mists Set (Legendary): 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Profane bonus to Physical Resistance Rating+30 Profane bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification+15 Profane bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+15 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
